name: My Best Buy Credit Card

annual_fee.waiver_conditions: Annual fee $0 to $59 based on creditworthiness.

apr.notes: Pricing as of 9/22/26: purchase APR 30.99% variable; minimum interest charge $2.

base_rate.description: Rewards are earned only on Best Buy purchases.

categories.label: Best Buy purchases when the rewards option is chosen

rewards.redemption_notes: Points are redeemable for Best Buy reward certificates ($5 certificate for every $100 spent) and gift cards. Cardholders choose rewards or flexible financing.

notes: Closed-loop Best Buy store card issued by Citi; usable only at Best Buy, so network is other. The page offers 10% back in rewards on the first day of purchases for new cardmembers. Annual fee ranges from $0 to $59 by creditworthiness, so annual_fee.amount is null.
